name: get_configuration
description:
Retrieve an installed integration configuration by ID. The authenticated account or selected team must own the configuration.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/integrations/configuration/{id} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

id.description: ID of the configuration to check

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
